title: Train-only first-difference ridge regression
authorship: Automated agent; no independent human/domain-expert review
freezeCommit: Use the commit adding this ledger and the predictions; controller records the immutable commit before scoring.
method: Predict adjacent annual ladder changes with four standardized income/governance/inequality features; ridge penalizes all five coefficients including intercept. Forecast GDP independently from pooled-shrunk historical growth.

internalFinding.verdict: No pooled internal ladder improvement; selected estimate is near persistence. No post-trial grid expansion.

primaryExternalMetric: 2025 endpoint ladder MAE against persistence, matching score masks

validation.artifactReproduction: Two runner executions compared byte-for-byte SHA-256; passed.

limitations: Two temporal origins and at most two internal forecast years; seven-year stability untested.
Repeated countries, historical revisions, and later methodology choices prevent archived-as-of or blinded validation claims.
Strongest registered penalty selected at boundary; no evidence to expand the grid.
All five method results must be published; winner selection is exploratory.
